source.check: returned unopposed: nominations as printed in the Northern Whig (8 May 1958, p. 3, page image read), where contests were expected only for the Ballyholme aldermanship and the Ballyholme and Dufferin councillorships; the News-Letter (22 May 1958, p. 2) reports elections in those two wards only

note: Municipal elections, 21 May 1958; contests in Ballyholme and Dufferin wards. The aldermen of Castle, Clifton, Dufferin and Princetown wards and the councillors of Castle, Clifton and Princetown wards were returned unopposed (nominations, Northern Whig, 8 May 1958, p. 3) (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Northern Whig, 8 May 1958, p. 3 (council-audit, Nov 2026): Seat_Type set to Alderman (was Councillor); this contest is the ward's aldermanship, listed under "Alderman" in the nominations, as the other Bangor aldermanic files record it. The note no longer says all five aldermen were unopposed: the Ballyholme aldermanship was contested (C. F. Milligan and William Bailie nominated).
